usage: ‘焗豬扒飯’ is a noun referring to a specific dish featuring baked pork chop served with rice.
You can use ‘焗豬扒飯’ as the object of a sentence when ordering or talking about food.
It is uncountable in most cases, so you typically don’t add plural or measure words directly before it without a classifier.
You can combine it with verbs related to eating or ordering, such as ‘食’ (eat) or ‘叫’ (order).
It can also be part of a phrase describing a meal or a menu item.

examples.meaning: I ate baked pork chop rice today; it was very tasty.
